title: method: corrplot
description: Coordinate contract for layers[].method='corrplot' (JarvisPLOT adapter-native). Draws the long table emitted by the `correlation` transform: one cell per variable pair, glyph shape from style.method, size from |rho|, colour from rho. Coordinates are optional because x_index / y_index / rho are the transform's own output columns; state them only to point at a renamed column. In type-first YAML, use type: correlation_matrix: omit style for [corrplot, matrix], or set style: [corrplot, diamond]; the latter is one triangle and forbids type: full. Discover keys and values with `jplot cap styles`, then use `jplot man corrplot`.
x-jarvis-example:
type: correlation_matrix
data: samples
style: [corrplot, diamond]
corrplot:
  method: circle
  type: upper
  side: right
  stripe: alternate

coordinates.description: Required axes for corrplot: (none). Optional: x, y, c.
